records.jp: 最近ちょっとだけ、お腹にお肉がついた……かも？<CR>詩帆さんのお菓子が美味しすぎるせいかなあ
records.en_original: Have I gained some weight around my waist...? I bet it's all because of Shiho's tasty sweets.
records.en_auxiliary: Have I gained some weight around my waist...? I bet it's all because of Shiho's tasty sweets.
records.en: I think I've put on a little around my stomach lately... maybe?<CR>Could it be because Shiho-san's sweets are too delicious?

records.jp: じゃ、いっくよー！
records.en_original: Okay, here we go!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, here we go!
records.en: All right, here we go!

records.jp: あっ、愛央ちゃーん！<CR>こっちこっち！
records.en_original: Oh, hey Ao! Over here!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey Ao! Over here!
records.en: Ah, Ao-chaan!<CR>Over here, over here!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、今日も元気いっぱいだね
records.en_original: You seem energetic as always, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: You seem energetic as always, Hiori.
records.en: You're full of energy today too, Hiori-san.

records.jp: ほ、星崎さん……
records.en_original: A-Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: A-Ao...
records.en: H-Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: はあ、はあ……
records.en_original: *Pant* *pant*
records.en_auxiliary: *Pant* *pant*
records.en: *Pant* *pant*

records.jp: えっ、詩帆さんに日菜子さん！<CR>なんか息上がってない？
records.en_original: Shiho? Hinako? Why are you so out of breath?!
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho? Hinako? Why are you so out of breath?!
records.en: Huh, Shiho-san and Hinako-san!<CR>Aren't you both out of breath?

records.jp: もー、まだ準備運動しかしてないよ？<CR>このくらいでへばってちゃだーめ！
records.en_original: Oh, come on! That was only the warm-up! You can't be worn out already!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, come on! That was only the warm-up! You can't be worn out already!
records.en: Geez, we've only done the warm-up, you know?<CR>You can't be exhausted from just this!

records.jp: じゅ、準備運動でこれですか……！？
records.en_original: Th-that was only the warm-up?!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that was only the warm-up?!
records.en: Th-this was only the warm-up...!?

records.jp: 陽桜莉の運動神経の良さ、舐めてたかもね
records.en_original: We may have underestimated just how athletic Hiori is.
records.en_auxiliary: We may have underestimated just how athletic Hiori is.
records.en: We may have underestimated Hiori's athletic ability.

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんと一緒に運動してたんだ……）
records.en_original: (Oh, so they were exercising together.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, so they were exercising together.)
records.en: (So they were exercising together with Hiori-san...)

records.jp: あはは、陽桜莉さんは規格外なとこあるから……
records.en_original: Ahaha, I guess Hiori can come on a little strong.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I guess Hiori can come on a little strong.
records.en: Ahaha, Hiori-san is kind of beyond normal standards...

records.jp: まあ、大丈夫だって！　詩帆さんも日菜子さんも、<CR>普段ちゃんと戦えてるんだし！
records.en_original: Still, you'll be fine! Both of you fight on a regular basis!
records.en_auxiliary: Still, you'll be fine! Both of you fight on a regular basis!
records.en: Well, you'll be fine! Both Shiho-san and Hinako-san<CR>can fight properly all the time!

records.jp: あのね、二人が強いってことは<CR>私がちゃーんと知ってるけど……
records.en_original: I know full well that the two of you are strong, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I know full well that the two of you are strong, but...
records.en: Listen, I know perfectly well<CR>that both of you are strong, but...

records.jp: それはそれ、これはこれ！
records.en_original: Fitness and fighting are two different things!
records.en_auxiliary: Fitness and fighting are two different things!
records.en: That's one thing, this is another!

records.jp: リフレクターの力に頼ってばかりじゃなくて、<CR>地の体力も鍛えないとダメだよ！
records.en_original: You have to keep your body strong so you're not completely dependent on your Reflector powers!
records.en_auxiliary: You have to keep your body strong so you're not completely dependent on your Reflector powers!
records.en: You can't keep relying only on your Reflector powers.<CR>You need to train your basic physical strength too!

records.jp: うっ……！
records.en_original: Ugggh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugggh!
records.en: Ugh...!

records.jp: 正論……！
records.en_original: Can't argue with that...
records.en_auxiliary: Can't argue with that...
records.en: She's absolutely right...!

records.jp: ってことで、みんなで体力づくり！<CR>愛央ちゃんは、誰と何をする？
records.en_original: So, let's do some basic endurance training! Ao, which exercise would you like to do with whom?
records.en_auxiliary: So, let's do some basic endurance training! Ao, which exercise would you like to do with whom?
records.en: So, we're all building up our stamina!<CR>Ao-chan, what will you do, and with whom?

records.jp: ま、巻き込まれた！<CR>ええと……
records.en_original: I-I have to do this too?! Well, if I have to...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I have to do this too?! Well, if I have to...
records.en: I-I've been dragged into this!<CR>Um...

records.jp: 詩帆さんと、長距離走をしようかな
records.en_original: I guess I'll do long-distance running with Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I'll do long-distance running with Shiho.
records.en: Maybe I'll do long-distance running with Shiho-san.

records.jp: 長距離走、ですか。<CR>わたし、あまり運動は得意じゃなくて……
records.en_original: Long-distance? To be honest, I'm not sure I can handle that...
records.en_auxiliary: Long-distance? To be honest, I'm not sure I can handle that...
records.en: Long-distance running?<CR>I'm not very good at exercise...

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ！　一緒にゆっくり走ろう？
records.en_original: It'll be fine! We'll take it slow.
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fine! We'll take it slow.
records.en: It's okay! Let's run slowly together?

records.jp: はい。が、頑張ります……！
records.en_original: Okay. I-I'll try my best!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I-I'll try my best!
records.en: Yes. I-I'll do my best...!

records.jp: はあ…………<CR>……はあ……はあっ……！
records.en_original: *Pant* *pant* *pant*
records.en_auxiliary: *Pant* *pant* *pant*
records.en: Haa...<CR>...haa... haa...!

records.jp: も、もう……だめですぅ……！
records.en_original: I...I c-can't...go on!
records.en_auxiliary: I...I c-can't...go on!
records.en: I-I can't... anymore...!

records.jp: あと２キロ、引っ張ってあげるから<CR>もうちょっとだけ頑張ろ！
records.en_original: Just two more kilometers to go! You can do this!
records.en_auxiliary: Just two more kilometers to go! You can do this!
records.en: I'll pull you along for the last two kilometers,<CR>so let's keep going just a little longer!

records.jp: は、はい……<CR>ありがとうございますぅ……！
records.en_original: Th-thank you... I'll...try...!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thank you... I'll...try...!
records.en: Y-yes...<CR>Thank you...!

records.jp: 日菜子さんと短距離走がしてみたい！<CR>今は、膝の痛みもないんだよね？
records.en_original: I want to try sprinting with Hinako! Your knee is fine now, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I want to try sprinting with Hinako! Your knee is fine now, right?
records.en: I want to try sprinting with Hinako-san!<CR>Your knee doesn't hurt now, right?

records.jp: うん、大丈夫だよ。<CR>お手柔らかにね
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm okay. Go easy on me, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I'm okay. Go easy on me, though.
records.en: Yeah, it's fine.<CR>Go easy on me.

records.jp: はあっ……なかなか、タイムが伸びないなあ
records.en_original: Hmph... I can't seem to shorten my time.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph... I can't seem to shorten my time.
records.en: Haa... My time just won't improve.

records.jp: えっ？<CR>今でも十分、早いと思うよ？
records.en_original: Really? I thought that was pretty fast.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I thought that was pretty fast.
records.en: Huh?<CR>I think you're already plenty fast.

records.jp: うーん。<CR>膝を壊すまでは、もう少し早かったんだけど……
records.en_original: Mm... I used to be faster before I injured myself...
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... I used to be faster before I injured myself...
records.en: Hmm.<CR>I was a little faster before I injured my knee, though...

records.jp: ブランクがあるせいかな。<CR>膝の痛みがなくても、思うようにはいかないね
records.en_original: Maybe I've been away from the tracks for too long. My injury has healed, but I still can't run like I used to...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I've been away from the tracks for too long. My injury has healed, but I still can't run like I used to...
records.en: Maybe it's because I've been away from it for so long.<CR>Even without the knee pain, things don't go the way I want.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……そんな悲しそうな顔しないで？<CR>頑張り屋さんの日菜子さんなら、すぐ取り戻せるよ！
records.en_original: Hinako, please don't look so sad. I'm sure you'll be able to run like before again!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, please don't look so sad. I'm sure you'll be able to run like before again!
records.en: Hinako-san... Don't look so sad.<CR>You're such a hard worker, so you'll get it back in no time!

records.jp: ……ありがとう。愛央にそう言われると、<CR>なんとかなる気がしてくるから困っちゃうよ
records.en_original: Thank you. Your encouragement really helps a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. Your encouragement really helps a lot.
records.en: ...Thanks. The trouble is, when you say that, Ao,<CR>I start feeling like everything really will work out.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん！　私とかけっこで勝負だ！
records.en_original: Hiori! Let's race!
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori! Let's race!
records.en: Hiori-san! Race me!

records.jp: わあっ、いいねえ！<CR>負けないよ！
records.en_original: Awesome! You're going down!
records.en_auxiliary: Awesome! You're going down!
records.en: Wah, sounds good!<CR>I won't lose!

records.jp: じゃ、さっそく！<CR>位置について……よーい、どん！
records.en_original: On your marks! Get set! Go!
records.en_auxiliary: On your marks! Get set! Go!
records.en: Then let's get started!<CR>On your marks... get set, go!

records.jp: ゴーーール！<CR>えへへ、私の勝ち！
records.en_original: Yessss! Hehehe, I win!
records.en_auxiliary: Yessss! Hehehe, I win!
records.en: Gooaal!<CR>Ehehe, I win!

records.jp: くうっ、負けたあ！<CR>あとちょっとだったのにっ。
records.en_original: Aw, man! I was so close, too!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, man! I was so close, too!
records.en: Ghh, I lost!<CR>I was so close.

records.jp: 私も久々に、全力出しちゃった。<CR>愛央ちゃん、またやろうね！
records.en_original: I haven't run like that in forever! Let's do it again sometime!
records.en_auxiliary: I haven't run like that in forever! Let's do it again sometime!
records.en: It's been a while since I went all out too.<CR>Ao-chan, let's do it again!

records.jp: もちろん！<CR>今度は負けないよ！
records.en_original: Absolutely! I won't lose next time!
records.en_auxiliary: Absolutely! I won't lose next time!
records.en: Of course!<CR>I won't lose next time!

records.jp: ああ、楽しかったぁ！
records.en_original: Ahh, that was so fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, that was so fun!
records.en: Ahh, that was fun!

records.jp: つ、疲れました……けど、<CR>確かに、体力づくりは大切ですね
records.en_original: I'm...exhausted, but... I do know now how important daily exercise is.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...exhausted, but... I do know now how important daily exercise is.
records.en: I-I'm tired... but<CR>building up our stamina really is important.

records.jp: そうだね。陽桜莉に負けないくらい……
records.en_original: That's true. We've gotta get to Hiori's level, at least...
records.en_auxiliary: That's true. We've gotta get to Hiori's level, at least...
records.en: That's true. Enough to rival Hiori...

records.jp: ……は難しそうだけど、<CR>たまには思いっきり身体を動かさなきゃ
records.en_original: ...Okay, maybe not. But we should try to be active every once in a while!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay, maybe not. But we should try to be active every once in a while!
records.en: ...may be difficult, but<CR>we should really move our bodies with everything we have once in a while.

records.jp: そうだよ！　いっぱい汗を流せば<CR>身体と頭のモヤモヤは飛んで行っちゃうんだから！
records.en_original: Totally! Sometimes you just have to sweat away your problems!
records.en_auxiliary: Totally! Sometimes you just have to sweat away your problems!
records.en: That's right! If you work up a good sweat,<CR>the fogginess in both your body and mind will clear right up!

records.jp: だから、モヤモヤしたときは<CR>いつでも私を呼んで？　いくらでも付き合うよ！
records.en_original: So call me whenever you've got some issues to deal with! I'll help you work them out!
records.en_auxiliary: So call me whenever you've got some issues to deal with! I'll help you work them out!
records.en: So whenever you're feeling all bottled up,<CR>call me, okay? I'll keep you company as long as you need!

records.jp: あははっ、頼もしい！<CR>みんな、また一緒に運動しようね！
records.en_original: Hahah, I'm counting on you! Let's all do this again sometime!
records.en_auxiliary: Hahah, I'm counting on you! Let's all do this again sometime!
records.en: Ahaha, that's reassuring!<CR>Everyone, let's exercise together again!
